name: superquants
description: Superquants multi-skill suite for closed-loop quant research workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Nine connected skills for scoped quant research and modular result reporting.
interface.longDescription: A repo-local plugin that packages the Superquants workflow into nine composable skills covering idea triage, compact or full research design, data preparation, experiment planning, modular result reporting, debugging, robustness review, production handoff, and live review - with a trial registry for multiplicity accounting and a calibration ledger that feeds live results back into the research process.
defaultPrompt: Use Superquants to turn a strategy idea into a research spec.
Audit my quant dataset before I trust the backtest.
Review a promising strategy for robustness before promotion.
Run a live review on my deployed strategy.
